name: Sid (amostras Hahonih e Atsah)
why: Rocha vulcânica da formação Máaz, perto da base: registra a lava que cobriu o fundo do lago e foi alterada pela água.
whyEn: Máaz volcanic rock next to the base: records the lava that floored the lake and was later altered by water.
task: Fotografar a superfície abradida e coletar um núcleo de referência.
taskEn: Photograph the abraded patch and collect a reference core.
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sol ~371 (Sid sampling, Máaz formation)

name: Contato no assoalho (canal sinuoso)
why: A borda do canal expõe o contato entre o assoalho vulcânico e sedimentos mais novos: mostra a ordem dos eventos.
whyEn: The trough edge exposes the contact between volcanic floor and younger sediments, showing the order of events.
task: Fotografar o contato e medir a espessura da camada.
taskEn: Photograph the contact and measure the layer thickness.
source: Digitized on USGS CTX orthomosaic where the base→delta-front corridor crosses the floor trough (interpretation approximate)

name: Skinner Ridge e Wildcat Ridge (Hawksbill Gap)
why: Lamito com sulfatos e moléculas orgânicas (Wildcat Ridge) e arenito do delta: o melhor lugar para buscar bioassinaturas.
whyEn: Sulfate-rich mudstone with organic molecules (Wildcat Ridge) plus delta sandstone: the best spot to look for biosignatures.
task: Coletar núcleo do lamito e registrar as camadas da frente do delta.
taskEn: Core the mudstone and log the delta-front layers.
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sols ~490-516 (Skinner Ridge: Swift Run/Skyland; Wildcat Ridge: Hazeltop/Bearwallow)

name: Enchanted Lake
why: Primeiro afloramento da base da escarpa do delta: camadas finas depositadas em água parada.
whyEn: First outcrop at the foot of the delta scarp: thin beds laid down in still lake water.
task: Fotografar as camadas de perto (escala) e de longe (contexto).
taskEn: Photograph the beds close up (scale) and from afar (context).
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sol ~415 (Enchanted Lake, delta front)

name: Depósito Three Forks
why: Dez tubos de amostras deixados no chão para uma futura missão de retorno: verificar estado e posição.
whyEn: Ten sample tubes left on the surface for a future return mission: check their condition and position.
task: Inspecionar e fotografar cada tubo, sem tocar.
taskEn: Inspect and photograph each tube without touching it.
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sols 586-653 (Three Forks depot)

name: Rochette (Montdenier e Montagnac)
why: Primeiro núcleo bem-sucedido do Perseverance: basalto de Máaz com sais, sinal de água subterrânea.
whyEn: Perseverance's first successful cores: Máaz basalt with salts, a sign of groundwater.
task: Comparar a rocha com a amostra de Sid e fotografar os sais.
taskEn: Compare the rock with the Sid sample and photograph the salts.
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sols ~190-196 (Rochette on Artuby ridge, Máaz)

name: Brac (Salette e Coulettes), Séítah
why: Rocha rica em olivina formada em magma espesso e depois alterada pela água: guarda a história do lago.
whyEn: Olivine-rich rock from a thick magma body, later altered by water: it holds the lake history.
task: Coletar núcleo na borda leste de Séítah, longe das dunas.
taskEn: Core it on the east edge of Séítah, away from the dunes.
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sols ~262-271 (Brac, Séítah formation)

name: Issole (Robine e Malay), Séítah
why: Segunda rocha de olivina de Séítah: confirma se a alteração por água é a mesma em toda a unidade.
whyEn: Second Séítah olivine rock: checks whether the water alteration is the same across the unit.
taskEn: Abrade it and compare with Brac.
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sols ~337-347 (Issole, Séítah formation)

name: Camadas da cratera Belva
why: O impacto cortou o delta e expôs dezenas de metros de camadas inclinadas: um corte natural do rio antigo.
whyEn: The impact cut through the delta and exposed tens of metres of inclined beds: a natural section of the ancient river.
task: Panorama das paredes a partir da borda sul; não descer.
taskEn: Shoot a panorama of the walls from the south rim; do not descend.
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sols ~753-760 (Belva crater rim, delta top)

name: Blocos e conglomerados do topo do delta
why: Blocos trazidos pelo rio de fora da cratera: amostram rochas de toda a bacia de drenagem.
whyEn: Boulders carried in by the river from outside the crater: they sample rocks from the whole watershed.
task: Fotografar 3 blocos de cores diferentes com escala.
taskEn: Photograph three boulders of different colours with scale.
source: Perseverance waypoint (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints.json), sol ~1000 (upper fan, boulder-rich delta top); boulder identification approximate

name: Carbonatos da margem (CRISM)
why: Carbonatos formados na beira do lago: na Terra, esse ambiente preserva bem sinais de vida.
whyEn: Carbonates formed at the lake shore: on Earth, this setting preserves signs of life well.
task: Confirmar o carbonato com o espectrômetro e coletar núcleo.
taskEn: Confirm the carbonate with the spectrometer and collect a core.
source: CRISM FRT00005C5E CAR browse (PDS MTRDR): centroid of the southern strong-carbonate patch on the western margin
